$doc: Content for <PromiseSequence>: one delivery date surviving from ad to arrival, built from Paul's real 2019 screens. Slot names and their retina floors come from lib/bento-slots.json, the single source of truth that bento-crop's crop.py also reads — do not fork those numbers here.
$pendingDoc: CROPS ARE NOT DONE. `pending: true` makes the stage render as a labelled placeholder box at the correct slot aspect instead of a 404, so the page can be judged before the crops exist. Run bento-crop with Paul against the `source` files, drop the output at `src`, then flip pending to false — one boolean per stage, no code change. `alt` is written and waiting; review it before flipping.
$smsDoc: THE FOURTH STAGE IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The text-message screen is 375x667 and fails every floor. It is NOT to be rebuilt as markup: the physics rule is explicit that rebuilding product UI as markup presents a portfolio graphic as product UI. It is a closing line of prose in the MDX instead.
$captionDoc: AUTHORED IN THE BUILD, NOT DRAFTED — flagged for Paul. The content draft carries no captions or alt text for this module. Every caption, gloss and alt string below is a placeholder in the draft's register, for Paul to rewrite.
$deadPathDoc: THE `src` VALUES IN THIS FILE POINT AT PATHS THAT DO NOT EXIST, AND THAT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN FIXED. <PromiseSequence> was unmounted on 30 Aug and every stage here is `pending: true`, so the component renders a placeholder and never reads `src`. The paths were also always wrong: they omit the `solution/` segment the crops actually live under, and on 31 Aug pdp--standard.png was deleted outright when the walk re-cut its assets. Nothing breaks and nothing is repaired here. IT IS LOGGED BECAUSE IT IS THE FOURTH INSTANCE OF ONE PATTERN, alongside lib/bento-slots.json's stale ribbonTrackHeightPx, --fill-quiet's absence from every list in lint-color.mjs, and hero-block.tsx's over-declared `sizes`: A VALUE DECLARED IN ONE PLACE, SOMETHING ELSE RENDERED, AND THE TOOL CONSULTING THE DECLARATION REPORTING SUCCESS. Four of those is a class of defect this repo has no check for, which is the thing worth knowing. THE THREE `src` PATHS BELOW NAME FILES THAT HAVE NEVER EXISTED, confirmed 1 Sep: ad--wide.png, pdp--standard.png and cart--standard.png. Stated plainly because the entry above explains why the paths are WRONG without saying they are ABSENT, and those are different failures. The module is retired and unmounted, every stage is pending:true so the component renders a placeholder and never reads `src`, and nothing 404s today. IF ANYONE REMOUNTS IT, IT 404s AT BUILD. The stages array is kept rather than stripped because the alt strings and the crop reasoning in it are the record of what this module was for.
